decisions.reason: Although it is closely related to our installed base, its disappearance from the website after the 2023 launch suggests weak standalone demand or absorption into the core offer, so we should redeploy resources while retaining the learning in our existing anamnesis and mobile workflows.

Because this service builds on capabilities we already have in support and training but was no longer presented in 2024, the early market signal points to limited differentiation, and our absorptive capacity is better used by folding insights into the established service business rather than keeping a separate product.

This module fits very closely with our dental-practice software knowledge base and customer workflows, and as a 2024 launch still shown on the website it offers a strong platform for incremental improvement through our in-house R&D and user feedback.

Secure healthcare messaging is highly complementary to our core product, regulation-driven, and actively maintained as shown by the dedicated 2024 update, so our existing domain knowledge and development capacity give us strong ability to refine and commercialise it further.
